float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: The loop is the same recurrence; GNU Radio's atan2 and sincos differ from exact by about 2e-6 (measured 0.027 LSB, 126 dB over all 4000 samples, transient included: lock within 51 samples to 1 % of the frequency)

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The output is x * conj(NCO): sine table phase error pi/4096 rad times |x| 0.5 = 12.6 LSB, plus the loop following the table noise and the CORDIC residual, plus rounding (measured 17.4 LSB, 66.6 dB, from sample 200 on)
Table 14 bits: 3.1 LSB at |x| 0.5, plus loop and CORDIC effects (measured 5.1 LSB, 78.6 dB, from sample 200 on)
